text: Functional but flawed. Overall, the app works well enough. But there are two extremely annoying issues. The first is that only one person can be logged in at once. So if I am logged in, and my wife then logs in, I get kicked out. So we are both constantly having to login. The other issues is that it routinely “forgets” using our face to login. And the app will not remember it password. So we have to manually type in the login several times a week. It’s a very annoying issue for what is otherwise a good app.
Second RFID fountain now dead - both lasted less than one year. Two dead in less than two years

This app is so buggy to date. By far one of the worst apps I’ve had to use. Idk what happened but this app has been buggy since they made a major overhaul to it last year of the years before I believe. Nothing refreshes specifically the claims section and I have to uninstall and reinstall the app just to check where my claim is because it doesn’t show it. It’s as if it never gets filed. I’m not a fan of this app. In addition newer updates that they’ve released keep logging me out and I have to continue to login. Very frustrating
Lost. I cannot figure out how to use this app. I have taken Everett in and he’s had his second set of shots. I tried to submit the paperwork. And I can’t figure out how to submit it.

Trash Sensors You Can’t Trust. Fountain constantly says it’s out of water when it isn’t; there’s no window to SEE the water level so I have to take it apart to make sure, but it’s always more than 3/4ths full (WELL above the min line).  Happened today an hour after I filled it to the max and I can’t make it work again at all. Splurged on the eversweet 3 pro so my cat would have a nice fountain, and I should just throw it away because it doesn’t actually provide water.
Firmware update. After I did the firmware update it won’t connect to the internet no matter what I try, and I’ve tried everything!!
Updated app and it deleted my account. Worked fine until they forced update and now I can’t feed my pets. Thanks so much….

So far horrible. Signed up a few days ago, since then the app won’t upload my policy, their text support said it would take them an hour to email it to me, I tried calling for help and no one answered.

Bypasses PrivateRelay and Sign in with Apple. I don’t know why this is allowed on the App Store. I used private relay to not send my private email address to them when I signed in, but then they want me to verify my email address. It doesn’t work with private relay and they even put a note when they ask for an email that it helps “ensure” something. Why are they allowed to do this? Can I make a new throwaway address on my own? Sure. But these games really waste my time. I spent good money for quality and privacy. I like the other products I have bought from them. But apparently my money, including buying supplies from them every month or so isn’t enough; they need more. They shouldn’t be allowed to say that you can sign in with Apple if they’re going to require you to use another email address. I think this is false advertising and I don’t normally leave reviews like this. Their physical products have been great. But this is so disappointing it is hard to express. I will return the feeder over this. I guess selling my private information is more profitable than having me as a loyal repeat customer. Thinks a real shame!

Addition: I made a temp email to at least see how this would work and it now requires my location?!? What does that have to do with anything?! Why does a device I am trying to get on WiFi need my location?

Cats are Afraid. I purchased this product with such high hopes. It is very expensive and I was going out of town for three weeks. I have had it set up and tried to introduce my cats to it very slowly, but none of them are having anything to do with it. When I did put one cat in it. It quickly jumped out and scattered litter everywhere. I have people coming in to check on my cats and I have had to make them go and buy an old litter box at Walmart in place of the $600 litter box. I would not recommend this.
My PetKit feeder constantly disconnects from wifi. I put in the correct PW for wifi and it still says “cannot connect”. Garbage software. Connecting to wifi should be the easiest thing it does.

Poorly functioning. I use the SD card to record rather than the cloud subscription. Petlibro seems to intentionally makes using an SD card as frustrating as possible. I’m not just talking about it loading slow, they make it as many clicks as possible to view clips for literally no reason and so many ads. I’m a vet and I used to recommend Petlibro to clients because you could still use them without a subscription, but with how annoying the app is and how it tries to trick you into thinking you need a subscription made me think twice about that.
App and litter box don’t work. The main reason I bought this is because it cleans after the cat uses it but it doesn’t do that and the app doesn’t work at all

Slow, ad-filled, feature restricted. The fact that wirecutter recommended a pet feeder from this brand makes me reconsider if I should trust wire cutter. The app is barely usable on older iPhones. It constantly shows me apps for other products of the brand.
Spam and dark patterns. Knock it off, it’s not cute
Santana family. It is so easy to install it

Glitchy. I updated the app and trusted everything would be normal. Just to find out the app is not glitching every time I open it and my cats aren’t being fed when I’m not home. 
At first I loved this app. Now? I feel like they don’t stop trying to get me to sign up for things and sell me BS. Add onto that, the glitching.
Clogs and overflows. After less than a year of use it has started to clog and overflow. I have kept it clean including the inside of the filter fountain unit.

Had high hopes, only a high price. I bought the newer version of the automatic cat feeder and hoped that paying a high price for a feeder would be worth it. I enjoy being able to feed my cat from anywhere through my phone, but I usually am unable to do this as the app glitches regularly. At least once a week I have to delete the PetLibro app because it will not load or reconnect to my device. Then I have to re-sync my device while it is directly next to my phone. So it’s not reliable, cost a fortune, oh and the battery only lasts one day after only 5 months of ownership. So it’s no longer cordless, too.

Only use if you don’t need to share the app. They have made the process of sharing this with multiple people horrendous. The process they tell you to follow is inaccurate, you can’t even sign in on more than one phone. I assume that helps boost your numbers for ads and stuff.

Arrives only partially operational. This system requires a subscription to be fully functional. For the moment you start setting it up it hard sells you on hundreds of dollars of upgrades. It’s easy to make you feel like you have made a mistake when your brand new machine requires hundreds of dollars worth of upgrades to work properly.
Too many ads. I’ve already bought your expensive equipment, why do I still need to see your endless ads EVERYTIME I need to use it?

Poor measurement. The volume of the food choices are ridiculous.  It shouldn’t be this hard to set food amounts.  In addition using gram  is unnecessary.  In America, measurements are by cups or ounces not grams.  There should be a way in settings to convert it.

Come ON GUYS!!!. It was suddenly down today. Then up for about an hour in Massachusetts time. Now for their nighttime feeding you’re broken again. When we are away from our pets we EXPECT our pets to not have to Starve for HOURS! Please get it together ASAP!
Live vet chat. Live vet chat doesn’t work

No Real Working Number for Support. I pay over $120/mo for my pup. When I went to try to change my policy, there way to do it has so many loops to jump through, and their phone numbers don’t work either. Because of this, I’ve emailed them to cancel my subscription. I can’t be paying this much and not get a working phone number. Not one. Costco’s pet insurance looks more feasible and they answer their phones.

Initial setup keeps timing out. Clearly something missed QA. We just unboxed our pre libre and were quite excited until we attempted to set it up. Since then basically ever button as resulted in “request timeout”. Overall it has been very much a bad initial experience especially given we can use the feeder until this is resolved.

Too many ads in app. Shows many ads about other products in the home page.
I get you want to sell us other stuff, but a least put those in another tab or something, don’t clutter the home page that only need the item I own/use.
App itself is functional but some settings are hidden in tab instead of the gear icon on the top right is counterintuitive.

Only one login. Why can only one person be logged in at a time? Every time either me or my husband logs in, it has to log the other of us out and then always have to log back in. Make it so it can be logged in on multiple devices. This shouldn’t be hard as all my other WiFi devices are set up this way

Fantastic! Cleaner than a water bowl. I have used the system for two cats for about 10years.  I felt confident that my “kids” had good clean water. It takes very little effort on my part to provide the best.
Notifications ruin this app. I just want notifications when to refill or empty something. But it constantly notifies you of ads and other nonsense things.

AI Pet Recognition Sucks. I have two cats, one white and one black. The AI almost never recognizes the black cat and labels him as “pet”.

A few times the AI even mistook the white cat for the black one…like how can you screw that up?

Sorry but for how much this fountain costs it is severely underwhelming.
Cannot use device due to app bug. Impossible to select WiFi for device because the app redirects to the wrong screen in iPhone settings
Not working after update. After the update yesterday my device is not working. It will not open or reset. I’ve only had it for about 2 months. Not very happy about this.

If you value privacy tread not here. For whatever reason, this app is requesting my precise location in order to connect a device over WiFi. This is shady at best. Even worse the account deletion feature does nothing. If you value your personal data, avoid this company’s apps and products.
Notifications delayed. Lately I’ve been getting notifications for sound & motion HOURS later.

Cancelling Subscription Nonexistant. As others have said the app lets you subscribe but there is no way to stop the renewal. No cancellation option here, only to move it to another device, and their website does not manage subs made through the app. I submitted a ticket requesting cancellation as my only option.

No updates. I used to receive updates when my cat food was low. Now the app doesn’t give me any updates. I am not sure what is happening. But having a notification when the food was low is extremely helpful

Up and Coming. I really enjoy the products and PETKIT customer service has always been supportive— The app is a little clunky but it has improved over time. I’d like to see them figure out a different way to advertise. The way it’s set right now makes it difficult to navigate through the app

Find a different brand. It stopped tracking my cats. It worked great for about 3 days. Then all the sudden, nothing!!!  It says they weigh 3 pounds and worried about a kitten… my cats are 9.3#, 10.2#, and 16.7#..I wouldn’t buy this brand again.
